mapper.sql: r.id, r.trip_id, r.content, r.expense_changed, r.status, r.current_approval_step, r.decided_by, r.rejected_reason, r.created_at, r.updated_at, bt.user_id, u.name AS member_name, t.name AS team_name, bt.destination, bt.purpose, bt.start_date AS trip_start_date, bt.end_date AS trip_end_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business_trip_reports(trip_id, content, expense_changed, status, current_approval_step) VALUES(#{tripId}, #{content}, #{expenseChanged}, #{status}, #{currentApprovalStep})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM business_trip_reports r JOIN business_trips bt ON bt.id = r.trip_id JOIN users u ON u.id = bt.user_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM business_trip_reports r JOIN business_trips bt ON bt.id = r.trip_id JOIN users u ON u.id = bt.user_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE r.trip_id = #{tripId}
SELECT FROM business_trip_reports r JOIN business_trips bt ON bt.id = r.trip_id JOIN users u ON u.id = bt.user_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE r.trip_id IN #{tid}
mapper.update: UPDATE business_trip_reports SET current_approval_step = #{stepOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business_trip_report_expenses(report_id, expense_type, description, amount, note, display_order) VALUES(#{reportId}, #{expenseType}, #{description}, #{amount}, #{note}, #{displayOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT id, report_id, expense_type, description, amount, note, display_order FROM business_trip_report_expenses WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY display_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business_trip_report_files(report_id, stored_filename, original_filename, content_type, file_size) VALUES(#{reportId}, #{storedFilename}, #{originalFilename}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize})
mapper.select: SELECT id, report_id, stored_filename, original_filename, content_type, file_size, created_at FROM business_trip_report_files WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY id
